TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Obtains information about the pricing rule. Allows you to filter by various parameters.
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains ABKOR000, initializes DataPricingRuleGet and validates pricingRuleId; when pricingRuleId is not null and is less than 0, it adds advice ABKO00000050, sets Severity.WARN, initializes pricingRules with an empty list, calls setDataofpricingrules(dataPricingRuleGet) and returns. 2. Decisions and branches: after the validation branch, execute() copies pricingRuleId, pricingRuleType, pricingRuleStatus, fromDate, toDate, activityId, segmentId, settlementId, onlyActive, pageNumber, sizeOfPage, attributeDesc and attributeName into PricingRuleGetFilterParams; in ABKOR000Impl, pageNumber and pageSize default to 1 and 10 when they are null or non-positive, fromDate defaults to 1900-01-01 when empty, toDate defaults to 9990-12-31 when empty, onlyActive is translated into the active query value, pricingRuleStatus builds statusList and statusFlag, and pricingRuleType builds typeList and typeFlag. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules logs the received filters, builds the query parameters, calls jdbcUtils.queryForString(GET_COUNT_QUERY, params), builds paginationOut with buildPaginationDTO, and when totalElements is not 0 calls jdbcUtils.queryForList(GET_PRICING_RULES_QUERY, params) and maps each row with mapToPricingRuleGetDTO into pricingRules. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: ABKO00000050 is emitted when pricingRuleId is negative and ABKO00000040 is emitted when dataPricingRuleGet.getPricingRules().isEmpty() after the library call; both advices are followed by setSeverity(Severity.WARN). 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: setDataofpricingrules(dataPricingRuleGet) is called in the negative pricingRuleId branch and after the library call; paginationOut is always set from totalElements, pageNumber and pageSize, pricingRules is set to Collections.emptyList() when totalElements equals 0 and otherwise to the mapped query result.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves pricing rules by building query parameters from the received filters, calculating pagination metadata and executing the database queries. Maps each returned row into PricingRuleGetDTO, including related entities, payment methods and custom attributes.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.
